calibration.convention: uniform dopant arm absorbs the target power, state B, summed over the doped mask (FROZEN_CONVENTIONS_2D section 3)

recommendation.advice: The mode helps but leaves real anisotropy, between the winners' band and the failures' band. Solve the map against this mode's averaged kernel and expect the map to be load bearing rather than a finish.

conventions.objective: J = sum over the whole domain of (phi - chi_area)^2
conventions.stop: argmin of J over the arm's own trajectory; horizon flagged
conventions.grid_qualifier: grid 120; grid-120 fidelity does not transfer to 160
conventions.dose: uniform arm calibrated to 500 W/m; solved arms NOT dose matched

continuous.gauge_note: positions are the HALF-TURN-DISTINCT ones: theta and theta + 180 degrees are the same part-frame heating to 4e-13 relative (DWELL_SCHEDULE_REPORT section 2), so the literal program is halved without changing the physics

verdict.note_on_prediction: the prediction is that the RECOMMENDED actuator class produces the best arm; when rotation is recommended, any rotating arm counts, because the near-tie indexing arms are part of the same recommendation
